cases.method: N01 context cancellation waits for fetch termination and releases its lock
cases.coverage: context受控请求取消，终止确认后释放自有锁；无业务写入。

cases.method: N02 preview cancellation invalidates its plan immediately and on termination
cases.coverage: preview协作取消，操作信号传播；失效预览不可绑定。

cases.method: N03 uncooperative work remains locked after the five second target
cases.coverage: 忽略取消的本地步骤超过5秒仍等待，锁定且拒绝并发写入；实际结束后释放。

cases.method: N04 a late plan is discarded and a later preview stays independent
cases.coverage: 取消后迟到结果不能返回可用token或留下plan；下一次预览独立。

cases.method: N05 success and cancellation publish exactly one terminal outcome
cases.coverage: 取消/成功竞争只产生一个终态，成功赢时正常token可用，取消赢时拒绝。

cases.method: N06 repeated cancellation is idempotent and cannot cancel the next operation
cases.coverage: 重复取消同一操作幂等，不取消后续操作。

cases.method: N07 other senders frames pages and identifiers cannot cancel the owner
cases.coverage: 外窗口、子框架、错误页面及旧操作ID不能取消当前操作。

cases.method: N08 successful preview retains its token and normal request result
cases.coverage: 正常context/preview完成，锁释放，预览及后续原确认流程可用。

cases.method: N09 network errors and timeouts clean up before another read
cases.coverage: 网络失败和超时受控失败，资源/监听器/锁清理，可再次执行。

cases.method: N10 JSON request preserves caller cancellation through fetch
cases.coverage: JSON读取期间取消，停止读流且释放reader；会话、重定向及大小限制保持。

cases.method: N11 binary cancellation closes the reader and digest validation is retained
cases.coverage: 二进制读取取消资源清理；原摘要、大小、空文件限制不放宽。

cases.method: N12 writes keep their original exclusive flow and do not accept read cancellation
cases.coverage: 写操作不接受预览取消，也不能与取消未确认的预览并发。

cases.method: N13 project sync context uses the shared read lifecycle
cases.coverage: 逐个安装全部同步入口，context及自定义preview参数使用同一取消契约和原发送者检查。

cases.method: N14 every native transfer context and prepare uses cancellation and discards late tokens
cases.coverage: 全部迁移context/prepare使用同一契约，取消使对应客户端plan失效；commit保持原确认。

cases.method: N15 navigation and close cannot release a still running operation
cases.coverage: 页面离开或窗口关闭触发取消；未终止前不关闭，不能提前清全局锁。

cases.method: N16 normal transport retains caller signals redirect limits and write requests
cases.coverage: 无预览操作时传输正常，既有超时/调用者signal仍生效，不影响写请求。

cases.method: N17 each terminal outcome removes listeners and leaves no active owner reference
cases.coverage: 成功、取消及失败后移除本操作监听器/状态引用，不撤销别的操作资源。

cases.method: U01 cancellation control announces progress immediately and waits for the real terminal state
cases.coverage: 取消控件可键盘使用，点击立即显示正在取消；终态提示准确。

cases.method: U02 late polling and pagehide cannot overwrite a newer operation or draft
cases.coverage: 旧轮询/离页后的响应不得覆盖新页面或新操作状态。

cases.method: U03 an ordinary write has no read cancellation control and existing disabled controls stay disabled
cases.coverage: 只读活动显示取消控件；写操作无可取消入口，原控件保护保持。
真实离屏Electron中受控读取可取消，反馈实测≤1秒、终止确认及释放≤5秒。
真实窗口close请求在取消并释放锁后完成关闭，不显示/聚焦窗口。
真实离屏不可立即中断夹具超过5秒显示终止未确认并继续锁定，结束后才可关闭。
真实离屏迟到结果/失效token不能绑定；新窗口/新预览状态保持。
